patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring a single dominant image or video and prominent, centered typography.
Hero and section titles use an extremely large, elegant serif font, creating a strong visual hierarchy and a luxurious, editorial feel.
A deep, rich navy blue is used as a primary background color, providing a sophisticated backdrop for white text and subtle warm accents.
Hero elements (main title text, background video) parallax independently on scroll, with the text scaling down and moving up while the background shifts at a different rate.
Content sections reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, drawing attention to new information.
Large, numbered lists are used to present key information or steps, often paired with a large text block or a single impactful image.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex scroll-based animations. The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect where the main title scales down and translates upwards while the background video or image parallaxes at a different speed. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into view.
Full-bleed video backgrounds are used in hero sections, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility and enhance the sophisticated mood.
Employs a striking contrast between oversized, elegant serif display fonts for headlines and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, creating a sophisticated and editorial aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif hero and section titles (approx. 4-6x body text size) paired with a clean, well-spaced sans-serif for body copy and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small rounded corners on buttons and image containers).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around large typographic elements, creating a sense of luxury and breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, elegant serif typography for hero and section titles, combined with sophisticated scroll-triggered parallax and reveal animations, creates a highly luxurious and editorial brand experience that feels more like a digital magazine than a typical product page. The dramatic scale of the type is its most memorable feature.
